summary: Iteration 6 — tested Version Snapshots + Baseline Slippage end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 snapshot tests pass (POST/GET/restore/compare + legacy /versions). MSP/Asta/XER export regression (10/10) still green — Asta XSD ordering bug flagged in iter5 has been fixed. Frontend: full happy path passes — Snapshots (N) dropdown, save-snapshot modal with count increment, baseline selector with 19 options, 73 baseline bars rendered in Gantt, BL Start/BL Finish toggle on/off, Manage snapshots dialog with per-row Set-as-baseline + Restore buttons, calendar/variance/AI drawer regressions intact. Old standalone Snapshot / Versions toolbar buttons are gone as required.
critical_code_review_comments: Workspace.jsx is now ~900 lines with 5 dialogs, several dropdowns and lots of local state. Consider extracting SnapshotsMenu, SaveSnapshotDialog and SnapshotsListDialog into their own components — currently violates the >700-line guideline and mixes toolbar rendering with snapshot business logic.

GanttChart.jsx workingDayOffset caps at 20000 iterations (per problem statement) — silent cap; if a baseline finish is beyond ~55 years the baseline bar would render at the wrong offset with no warning. Prefer computing offset from a working-day index built once from projectStart, or at least console.warn on cap hit.

server.py _save_snapshot writes to db.versions but the response models are inconsistent — legacy POST /versions returns {id,version,label,created_at} while POST /snapshots returns the richer summary with activity_count. Fine for BC, but document this in the endpoint docstrings.
compare endpoint reruns full CPM on the baseline project every call — for large programmes with many baseline switches this could be slow. Consider caching baseline schedule keyed by snapshot_id.

_diff_days silently returns None on missing/invalid dates; the frontend treats None as 'no data' but the DataGrid variance column colouring logic should be re-checked so None does not render as green/zero variance.
seed_data_creation: Used existing project ed60c71a-2483-4e54-b062-e9414efe35ce. Backend tests take a TEST_restorepoint snapshot on setup and restore it on teardown so the shared project state is preserved. context_for_next_testing_agent: Snapshots + baseline slippage feature is fully working end-to-end. Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_snapshots_baseline.py and use a restore-point teardown pattern to keep the shared project stable. Frontend flow verified via Playwright: snapshots-menu → save-snapshot-menu / snapshot-name-input / save-snapshot-confirm; baseline-selector picks snapshot → 73 gantt-baseline-* rects render; toggle-baseline-cols adds/removes BL Start / BL Finish grid columns; manage-snapshots-menu opens snapshots-list with set-baseline-{id} + restore-{id} rows. Post-login lands on '/' (not '/dashboard') — worth remembering for future scripts.
